display_name: The Four Hundred and Forty Martyrs of Italy

names.note: Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's third heading for the Julian 2 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Четири стотине и четрдесет мученика.“ The heading is the whole of what the Prologue gives them: a number and the word мученика, and no personal name at all, so nothing could be stripped as a rank without leaving the form empty. The body names none of them either.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 2 марта ст. ст., name page 7970, «440 Италийских мучеников», with the rank and office words left off. The company has no personal name and the form is the whole of what the calendar’s index carries for it, the number with the toponymic and the grade — the grade is the name here, as it is on the corpus’s other company folders. The day’s own line writes it «Мчч. 440 Италийских», with the grade abbreviated and the noun left out. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form.

death.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 2 March: „Четири стотине и четрдесет мученика, који бише убијени од Лонгобарда у Италији око 579. године.“ The page says about the year 579, not 579, and it is the only source read for them.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 марта ст. ст. — «Мчч. 440 Италийских (ок. 579).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for 2 martie, which is the page for this menologion number — not 15 martie, which merely shares their civil date in 2026.

Not checked: saint.gr's εορτολόγιο for 2 Μαρτίου, which is the page for this menologion number. The corpus holds the two other entries of that Greek day, `theodotus-of-kyrenia` and `troadius`, and neither page read for them names this company.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 15.03.2026 (2. март ст. ст.) — „Четири стотине и четрдесет мученика.“

attestations.note: The day's third entry, three sentences long. The heading enumerates nobody and the body names nobody, so by the settled rule a company the source does not name is one folder and not four hundred and forty. The Prologue is the only one of the four calendars read for them.
